latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of godfery-automation-workflows.

- Provides a step-by-step playbook for identifying, designing, and implementing automation workflows for solopreneurs.
- Covers automation opportunity identification, tool selection (Zapier, Make, n8n), workflow design, building, testing, and ongoing maintenance.
- Includes checklists, workflow templates, troubleshooting tips, and error handling best practices.
- Offers advanced automation examples for client onboarding and content distribution.
- Designed to help solopreneurs save time and reduce manual work with no-code automation tools.
